source_mutations: Only private ambient.py proposal; no tests/artifacts/other app files changed.
design: One <=48MiB RGB32 raster of existing paint_base+engine.blit on second same-frame partial expose, actual painter device DPR, immutable frame retained with identity/cacheKey; whole/fresh/ineligible paths remain existing renderer.
invalidation: republish/rebuild/stop/hide/wallpaper/card changes, watched parent resize/screen move; key handles direct widget size/DPR/frame/mode/base changes on next paint.
limitation: No new resizeEvent override; direct widget resize invalidates by changed key on next paint rather than eagerly freeing before that paint. Root may require stronger immediate event hook.
required_generator_review: New private AmbientWidget._paint_partial_frame docstring, no public docstring/signature/user text changes. Before final integration run normal documentation source extraction/freshness to establish whether private symbol changes any generated API source; never hand-edit artifacts.
required_tests: Root/qt_ci owning original timing plus exact pixel/key/lifetime/fresh-frame/eligibility/resize/DPR/zoom/ruler cohort; no threshold change.
root_review: Approved for validation only; allocation/configuration now inside exception fallback, direct producer start and graphics-frame reset explicitly clear cache.
format_guard: Only RGB32/ARGB32/ARGB32_Premultiplied actual QImage paint surfaces. QWidget route checks active QPaintEngine.paintDevice() and ordinary screen depth24/32; RGB30/64-bit/float/unknown surfaces fail closed. No pixels converted/inspected and no ephemeral backend device retained.
scope_limit: Native HDR/unsupported backend wrappers get original path. Exact fractional-DPR/device-origin parity pending Qt owning tests; no performance/pixel acceptance claimed.
documentation: Root documentation audit confirms new direct private helper changes no public API/nested inventory/locale records; no extra helper-only generators required.
parity_correction: One exact copied event QRegion and device transform in cache key; identical logical clip on build. Fractional DPR, nonidentity world transform, nonuniform/sheared/projective/nonintegral device phase fall back. Explicit user clip must equal eventregion; nonempty native systemClip must equal deviceTransform.map(eventregion); unknown/no clip falls back. Native equality/performance pending owning tests.
